object.name: bread_box
object.contact_parameter_semantics: MuJoCo friction sliding/torsional/rolling; defaults solref/solimp retained. No direct restitution mapping.
object.com_warning: COM is 0.19 m below lowest collision point; cannot describe positive mass confined to these seven solids. Preserve official model for parity; never silently recenter.

contact.velocity_formula: v_com_world = v_root_world + omega_world cross (R(q_box) @ com_root); MuJoCo free-joint angular qvel is body-local

sensor_contract.semantics: future physical contacts must filter actual enabled geoms; object_contact is desired intent, not force or bilateral contact

contact.distance_semantics: MuJoCo mj_geomDistance on primitive geoms at recorded body poses; negative = primitive overlap, positive = separation. Min pair penetration is not compound minimum translation or measured force. No dynamics stepped. Exact EEF alignment is a geometric translation probe, not a joint-reachability proof.
contact.marker_semantics: Official fixed EEF and target retained as soft semantic markers. Marker equality is not a physical contact constraint.

physical_validation.slip: force-weighted contact-point relative tangential speed integral; separate from object displacement

compiled_original.diagnostic_adapter: P6 spec A1; exact immutable manifest, missing V3 only

root_frame: original bottom-plate centre; local Z-up; world wxyz; root distinct from COM
